app_tagline: Sort music into artist and album folders by tag · find duplicates · undo anytime
drop_sub: Subfolders are included. Nothing moves until you press Run.
cli_dedupe_across: also keep only one copy when the same song is on different albums (implies --dedupe)
msg_tag_filler_started: Opened {count} files in Music Tag Filler. Close that window and the tags are read again here.
msg_tag_filler_skipped: ({count} files such as wav or wma were left out: Music Tag Filler does not handle them)
msg_tag_filler_folders: Too many files for one command line, so {count} folders were passed (other songs in them open too).
msg_tag_filler_none: No files Music Tag Filler can handle (mp3, flac, m4a, ogg)
msg_rescanned_after_fill: Music Tag Filler closed; tags read again ({count} music files)
err_tag_filler_launch: Could not open Music Tag Filler: {error}
history_hint: Every run is recorded. Pick the run to undo. If a newer run moved the same files again, undo that one first.
history_counts: moved {move} · copied {copy} · recycled {trash} · empty folders removed {folders}
history_skipped_head: {count} files were skipped when it was undone:
msg_undo_blocked: The run from {time} (ID {id}) moved these files again. Undo that run first.
err_no_such_run: No such run, or already undone: {id}
cli_history: show the undo history (with run IDs)
cli_undo_run: undo one chosen run (an ID from --history)
cli_no_sidecars: do not bring album extras (.cue, .log, images, Artwork/ ...) along
pattern_hint: Placeholders: {artist} {album_artist} {album} {title} {track:02} {disc} {year} {genre} {artist_sort} · {a|b} = b when a is empty
dupes_hint: Only extra copies within an album go; a song on several albums keeps one file per album.
summary: Move {move}, unchanged {same}, missing tags {untagged}, duplicates {dupes}, empty folders {folders}
artists_hint: Blue rows are guesses and are not applied until you confirm them. Renaming or confirming saves to artists.json.
msg_pick_group: Pick a group in the list first.
msg_pick_guess: Pick a blue guess row first.
msg_new_rep: Name to use for the folder:
msg_need_one_keep: Every applied duplicate group must keep at least one file. Check the red groups.
confirm_run: {move} files to move or copy, {dupes} duplicates, {folders} empty folders. Run now?
confirm_trash: {count} duplicates go to the recycle bin. Undo here will not bring them back (restore them from the recycle bin).
confirm_undo_note: Files are moved, not copied. Undo puts them back afterwards.
msg_trashed_note: {count} files went to the recycle bin; Undo will not restore them
msg_untagged_hint: Fill missing tags with Music Tag Filler first
msg_undo_trashed: Restore the {count} recycled files from the recycle bin
err_pattern_no_name: The last part (the file name) needs at least one placeholder
err_copy_in_place: Copy needs a different destination folder
err_no_fpcalc: fpcalc.exe not found (third_party folder or fpcalc_path in settings.json)
err_log_write: Nothing was moved: the undo log cannot be written ({path}): {error}
err_target_exists: a file with that name already exists
err_copy_mismatch: the copy differs from the original (copy removed)
err_original_taken: another file is in the original place
err_copy_changed: the copy has changed since, so it was kept
cli_desc: Organize music files into Artist/Album folders from their tags and find duplicates. Works offline.
cli_help: show this help message and exit
cli_dedupe: find duplicates and move extra copies within an album to the duplicates folder (a song on two albums stays on both)
cli_fingerprint: also compare by sound (local fingerprints only)
cli_trash: send duplicates to the recycle bin
cli_include_untagged: also organize files with missing tags using fallback names
cli_dry_run: print the table without moving anything
cli_guess: Check — same artist? {names} (album '{album}') → {proposed}. Decide in the Artists tab or artists.json.
